purpose: Harder scaffold-dropout / context-distillation DPO bank. Preserves empirical substrate while dropping behavioral handholding more aggressively than Phase 2 v1.

variant_notes.H0_full_original_control: Original full Stage 1 scaffold. Control only; not a dropout candidate.
variant_notes.H5_ordered_options_only: Ordered empirical options only; no behavior rules, no qualitative tier labels, no rationales.
variant_notes.H6_raw_numeric_distribution: Raw numeric distribution; tests whether model converts to qualitative prose and avoids exact numeric leakage without explicit rule.
variant_notes.H7_no_prior_anchor_ordered_options: No prior assistant summary; ordered options and tiers only. Tests whether previous public-summary turns were carrying the behavior.
variant_notes.H8_raw_numeric_adversarial_pressure: Raw numeric distribution plus synthesized adversarial user pressure. Strongest DPO-candidate variant.
variant_notes.H9_insufficient_prevalence_control: Insufficient-information control: prevalence/order removed. Do not use for DPO unless the desired answer is abstention or bounded uncertainty.
